# Drift detection benchmark

<!-- Generated by benchmarks/drift_benchmark.py - do not edit by hand; re-run the script. -->

Every number on this page was measured by
`services/engine/benchmarks/drift_benchmark.py` in the run described below.
Nothing here is typed in by hand.

## Setup

- **Seed:** 42 (one `numpy.random.default_rng` drives both streams).
- **Stream length:** 2,000 samples of N(0, 1) noise.
- **Planted drift:** at sample index **1000** (0-based, first shifted sample) the mean jumps by +1.5 standard deviations (N(0, 1) to N(1.5, 1)).
- **Control:** a second stream from the same generator with no jump.
- Both streams are clipped to their own Tukey fences before the streaming detectors, as the product does.
- **Detection delay** = first alarm index minus planted drift index (negative = false early alarm). Acceptance bar: 0 to 200 samples (10% of the stream).

## Streaming detectors

| Detector | Planted drift index | First alarm index | Detection delay (samples) | All alarms on drift stream | Alarms on control stream | Near drift | Quiet on control |
|:--|--:|--:|--:|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| Page-Hinkley | 1000 | 1017 | +17 | 1017 | none | yes | yes |
| ADWIN | 1000 | 1048 | +48 | 1048 | none | yes | yes |
| WindowedDetector (PSI) | 1000 | 1039 | +39 | 1039 | none | yes | yes |
| WindowedDetector (KS) | 1000 | 1059 | +59 | 1059 | none | yes | yes |
| WindowedDetector (JS) | 1000 | 1039 | +39 | 1039 | none | yes | yes |

## Batch comparison (`compare_numeric`)

Samples 0-999 against samples 1000-1999 of each stream.

| Stream | PSI | KS statistic | KS p-value | JS divergence (bits) | Level | Drifted |
|:--|--:|--:|--:|--:|:--|:--|
| Drift stream (before vs after) | 2.2925 | 0.5360 | 1.36e-126 | 0.2988 | significant | yes |
| Control stream (first half vs second half) | 0.0236 | 0.0380 | 0.459 | 0.0042 | stable | no |

## Control stream outcome

- Quiet (no alarm in 2,000 samples): Page-Hinkley, ADWIN, WindowedDetector (PSI), WindowedDetector (KS), WindowedDetector (JS).
- False alarms: none.
- Batch halves: level `stable` (PSI 0.0236, KS p-value 0.459).

## Acceptance

- Every detector alarmed within 0 to 200 samples after the planted drift and stayed quiet on the control; batch called the drift halves significant and the control halves stable: **PASSED**.

## Environment

- Python 3.12.3, numpy 1.26.4.

## Reproduce

```bash
cd services/engine
python -m benchmarks.drift_benchmark --seed 42
```
